chars.H: HAMZA: a 36-year-old Moroccan man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.S: SALMA: a young Moroccan woman wearing a light pink hijab, a long loose beige coat and white sneakers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a small Casablanca office, SALMA leans over HAMZA's desk smiling and pointing at his phone that shows a beach photo; HAMZA looks up at her, surprised and delighted.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: HAMZA sits at his office desk alone, grinning mischievously with a raised eyebrow, rubbing his mitten hands together.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: HAMZA sits in front of a small camping tent on a beach at night under stars, ignoring the sea and the stars, daydreaming with a goofy smile, hand on his cheek.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: HAMZA stands in a small Moroccan apartment at a wall calendar, impatiently crossing off days with a marker, sighing.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In his apartment HAMZA holds up a small two-person camping tent with a cheeky smile, imagining things, looking at it excitedly.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SALMA walks shyly through an office corridor holding a folder to her chest, eyes lowered, modest and calm.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the office, HAMZA peeks over his computer monitor, staring in admiration at SALMA who is pouring tea at a small kitchen counter.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At sunset on a northern Moroccan beach with rocky hills, HAMZA and SALMA stand in front of one small tent; HAMZA looks nervous and hopeful, SALMA looks at the tiny tent, hesitant.
